translation_note: Each evaluation carries an English (`question_en`) and a French (`question_fr`) form. One side is the original input typed by the user; the other is automatically translated by gpt-4o (gpt-6-sol since 2026-10-01) through Phase 5 (EN→FR) or Phase 6 (FR→EN) of the evaluator. Translations are generally high-quality but may differ in wording from a natively-typed equivalent — keep this in mind when comparing API outputs across languages.
assertion_refresh_sql: SELECT DISTINCT T_WC_T2S_MOVIE.ID_MOVIE, T_WC_T2S_MOVIE.MOVIE_TITLE, T_WC_T2S_MOVIE.DAT_RELEASE, T_WC_T2S_MOVIE.ID_IMDB, T_WC_T2S_MOVIE.IMDB_RATING, T_WC_T2S_MOVIE.IMDB_RATING_WEIGHTED, T_WC_T2S_MOVIE.IMDB_VOTES, T_WC_T2S_MOVIE.POSTER_PATH, T_WC_T2S_MOVIE.RUNTIME, T_WC_T2S_MOVIE.TAGLINE, T_WC_T2S_MOVIE.ID_CRITERION_SPINE FROM T_WC_T2S_MOVIE JOIN T_WC_T2S_MOVIE_LOCATION ON T_WC_T2S_MOVIE_LOCATION.ID_MOVIE = T_WC_T2S_MOVIE.ID_MOVIE JOIN T_WC_T2S_LOCATION_ANCESTOR ON T_WC_T2S_LOCATION_ANCESTOR.ID_LOCATION = T_WC_T2S_MOVIE_LOCATION.ID_LOCATION JOIN T_WC_T2S_LOCATION ON T_WC_T2S_LOCATION.ID_LOCATION = T_WC_T2S_LOCATION_ANCESTOR.ID_ANCESTOR WHERE T_WC_T2S_LOCATION.LOCATION_NAME = 'France' AND T_WC_T2S_LOCATION.DELETED = 0 AND T_WC_T2S_MOVIE_LOCATION.LOCATION_ROLE = 'filming' ORDER BY T_WC_T2S_MOVIE.IMDB_RATING_WEIGHTED DESC LIMIT 15
comment: EVALUATIONS-024. A country covers the places it contains (T_WC_T2S_LOCATION_ANCESTOR, TMDB-MOVIE-PREPROCESS-048). Inception (Paris), Saving Private Ryan (Calvados) and The Intouchables (Paris, Merville-Franceville) are filming-linked to places in France and never to France itself: without the hierarchy they cannot come. Before 2026-10-19, 27 movies were shot "in France"; through the hierarchy, 1 796.
